pegasus_welcome: As soon as you step into Pegasus's forge, the heat from the furnace hits you in the face. The room vibrates to the rhythm of a heavy hammer striking an anvil. Pegasus, a broad-shouldered man with soot on his face and muscles like tree trunks, looks up from the shower of sparks. 'Ah! Looking for real steel? You've come to the right place, friend!'
pegasus_buy_success: Pegasus takes your gold, tosses it into an iron chest, and hands you your new weapon with a smile. 'Here! Feel that balance. Go out there and cleave some monsters with it. And bring your old weapon here, I'll just melt it down!'
pegasus_error_no_gold: Pegasus lowers his hammer and laughs loudly. 'Do you think I forge my swords for the pretty blue eyes of a poor adventurer? Come back when your satchel is heavy with gold!'
pegasus_max_level: Pegasus looks at the weapon on your back with awe. 'I can't make anything better for you, champion. You carry the Excalibur of Oaktaven. Take it to the Dragon!'
merilon_welcome: In stark contrast to the forge, Merilon's boutique is cool, tidy, and smells of polished leather and lavender. Gleaming breastplates and fine-mesh chainmail hang like works of art on the wall. Merilon, a slender elf in a spotless silk robe, smooths an invisible crease and looks at you haughtily. 'Ah... a traveler. Let's hope we can find something that... flatters your silhouette a bit, while keeping you alive.'
merilon_buy_success: Merilon takes your gold with two fingers and nods elegantly. 'An excellent choice. This ring mail fits your shoulders perfectly. Try not to get any stains on it in that muddy forest, please.'
merilon_error_no_gold: Merilon looks you over from head to toe, sighs deeply, and shakes his head. 'Quality has a price, my dear. With those few gold pieces, I can at most offer you a clean handkerchief. Come back when you are wealthy.'
merilon_max_level: Merilon clasps his hands theatrically. 'Mon Dieu! You already wear the God Armor! The fit, the brilliance... You are a living work of art. I can offer you nothing better.'
pegasus_buy_1: Pegasus hands you a thick branch and laughs out loud. 'Here! Better than nothing, greenhorn. Try at least not to poke your own eye with it!'
pegasus_buy_2: 'This dagger has seen better days, but the point is still sharp enough to surprise a forest rat. Watch out for tetanus!'
pegasus_buy_3: 'Look, this is finally starting to look like something. Good for cleaving wood and skulls. Hack away!'
pegasus_buy_4: 'A solid piece of ironwork. Classic, reliable, and heavy enough to make a highwayman reconsider his life choices.'
pegasus_buy_5: Pegasus slams his anvil proudly. 'Now you're speaking my language! Pure Oaktaven steel. Made to smash a troll right in his face!'
pegasus_buy_6: 'Watch your toes with this thing! One good swing and you'll pulverize the shield of any minotaur that crosses your path.'
pegasus_buy_7: 'Ideal for adventurers who prefer to keep monsters at a safe distance. Long, sharp, and deadly on both sides!'
pegasus_buy_8: Pegasus looks a bit disgusted. 'I had to source it from the elves... But well, the mechanics are razor-sharp. Aim between the eyes!'
pegasus_buy_9: 'See that blue glow on the blade? Those are magic runes, forged in the dead of night. It cuts through flesh like a hot knife through butter.'
pegasus_buy_10: 'A beastly weapon for a true veteran. The jagged knob breaks every bone it hits. This will give them sleepless nights in the forest!'
pegasus_buy_11: 'This sword glitters so hard it almost hurts your eyes. Perfect for shining on the town square and blinding monsters!'
pegasus_buy_12: 'Forged from solidified volcanic glass from the dark mountains. Feather-light, but sharper than Merilon's tongue. Be careful with it!'
pegasus_buy_13: Pegasus whispers: 'Made from the bones of a dragon hatchling... The steel hungers for the blood of its big green brother. Do you feel that heat?'
pegasus_buy_14: 'This steel fell from the stars. I had to hammer non-stop for three days to get it into this shape. You are nearly invincible.'
pegasus_buy_15: Pegasus hands over the sword with trembling hands. 'The ultimate masterpiece of my career. If you don't fell the Green Dragon with this, I don't know what will. Go and become a legend!'
merilon_buy_1: Merilon wrinkles his nose. 'It is... basic. But at least better than running around naked. Try not to get mud stains on it.'
merilon_buy_2: 'This leather is treated with special oils. It smells a bit strong, but it will at least keep those tiny squirrel teeth away.'
merilon_buy_3: 'Look at those steel rivets. A charming mix of functionality and texture. Very fashionable for the beginning hunter.'
merilon_buy_4: 'The rings fall smoothly around your waist. Comfortable enough to flee in, though of course I hope you'll just stand your ground.'
merilon_buy_5: 'Thousands of tiny, interconnected steel rings. Lightweight, elegant, and it rattles so nicely when you parade across the town square!'
merilon_buy_6: 'Slightly more compact and heavily executed. It hides your figure a bit, but it protects your vital organs against a mean troll.'
merilon_buy_7: 'The overlapping steel plates provide a beautiful horizontal line play. Strong against downward strikes, my dear!'
merilon_buy_8: Merilon beams with pride. 'My personal favorite from the basic collection. It shines like morning dew and weighs almost nothing. A pure delight.'
merilon_buy_9: 'Hand-engraved mythological patterns in solid bronze. You look like a god from the ancient tales. Beautiful silhouette!'
merilon_buy_10: 'Heavy steel plate armor for the serious knight. Don't forget to oil your joints, or the monsters will hear you coming from a kilometer away.'
merilon_buy_11: 'The woven silver threads in this armor absorb the shockwaves of magical spells. Functional and enchantingly beautiful.'
merilon_buy_12: 'Jet black and mysterious. It absorbs the light around you, making you look delightfully slender and intimidating in the shadow of the forest.'
merilon_buy_13: 'Made from the scales of fallen reptiles. This armor laughs at fire. Ideal if you plan on attending a barbecue anytime soon...'
merilon_buy_14: 'Blessed in the great cathedral. The golden trim radiates pure authority. Even the Necromancers will think twice before touching you.'
merilon_buy_15: Merilon makes a theatrical bow. 'The absolute pinnacle of haute couture and defense. Forged by the gods, worn by you. The Green Dragon will break his own teeth on your chest!'
pegasus_talk_1: 'A good sword is like a good friend: it never betrays you in the dark. Except if it's a rune sword, those tend to glow sometimes.'
pegasus_talk_2: 'Those elves across the street with their shiny armors... Beautiful, sure, but when a troll hits with a tree trunk, shine is useless. Then you need a heavy weapon to strike first!'
pegasus_talk_3: 'Did you know I once forged a sword for Master Kane? That man split a boulder in two as if it were a ripe melon. Good times.'
pegasus_talk_4: 'Don't ask me to make bows. Shooting arrows is for cowards who don't dare to smell what a monster had for breakfast.'
pegasus_talk_5: 'If your weapon feels blunt, you can go to the Bard in the inn. I hear his songs give magical sharpness. Strange, I'd rather use a whetstone.'
pegasus_talk_6: 'Transaction tip: I always give you 75% of the value of your old weapon back when you buy a new one. That's fair trade from Pegasus!'
pegasus_talk_7: 'What are you standing there dreaming for? The iron is hot, the coals are burning, and my time is precious. Buy or beat it!'
pegasus_talk_8: 'The monsters in the deep forest will laugh at you if you come there with a wooden stick. Buy proper steel before you end up as rat food.'
pegasus_talk_9: 'The Green Dragon has skin as hard as diamonds. If you want to make an impression there, you need at least a Dragonbone Spear or the God Sword.'
pegasus_talk_10: 'Be careful with that Rune Sword, the previous owner accidentally cut his own shoelaces with it because the blade is so razor-sharp!'
merilon_talk_1: 'Fashion and defense go hand in hand. What's the point of defeating the Dragon if you look like a slovenly orc?'
merilon_talk_2: 'Don't listen to that bellowing barbarian across the street. Pegasus makes weapons for peasants. My armors are made for connoisseurs.'
merilon_talk_3: 'If you die in the forest, the monster steals all your gold on hand. But you know what's even worse? They defile the armor I designed with so much love!'
merilon_talk_4: 'A Leather Vest is nice against a forest rat, but when a Werewolf sets its claws in you, it crumples like parchment. Upgrade in time, traveler.'
merilon_talk_5: 'I heard some travelers go into the forest naked for the challenge. Barbaric. Absolutely scandalous. The fashion police should lock them up!'
merilon_talk_6: 'Be careful with the Elven Breastplate. It reflects sunlight so perfectly you can blind monsters from a kilometer away.'
merilon_talk_7: 'Interest at the bank is nice, but investing in a gleaming plate armor is truly a safe investment in your future.'
merilon_talk_8: 'My prices are non-negotiable. Elegance knows no discount. Fortunately, you do get a neat trade-in price for your old rags.'
merilon_talk_9: 'The smell of that furnace across the street ruins the texture of my silk curtains. But well, a town needs a smith, no matter how rowdy he is.'
merilon_talk_10: 'Try to walk upright when you leave my shop. My armors only truly come into their own with a royal posture!'
smithy_welcome: `gYou walk onto the lively market. To the left you see the smoking forge of Pegasus, to the right the elegant boutique of Merilon.`w
alchemist_welcome:
`gYou step into a dark, mystic laboratory. Everywhere glass flasks bubble with strange, steaming liquids. An old alchemist with thick glasses looks up:

"Ah, an adventurer! Looking for extra strength for the forest? My elixers grant you temporary unprecedented power in your next battles. Choose wisely!"`w
